See prompt caching pricing for an explanation of the cache columns and pricing multipliers.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Model pricing
blocks.text: Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview use a newer tokenizer that contributes to their improved performance on a wide range of tasks. This tokenizer produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text. The exact increase depends on the content and workload shape. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier models use the previous tokenizer.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Platform on AWS pricing
blocks.text: Claude Platform on AWS bills through AWS Marketplace using Claude Consumption Units (CCUs). Anthropic rates your token usage in USD at standard per-model, per-feature rates, applies any negotiated discount, converts the result to CCUs at $0.01 per CCU, and reports the CCU quantity to AWS Marketplace hourly. Your AWS bill shows a single CCU line item.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text:  Prompt caching

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Prompt caching reduces costs and latency by reusing previously processed portions of your prompt across API calls. Instead of reprocessing the same large system prompt, document, or conversation history on every request, the API reads from cache at a fraction of the standard input price.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: There are two ways to enable prompt caching:

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Automatic caching: Add a single cache_control field at the top level of your request. The system automatically manages cache breakpoints as conversations grow. This is the recommended starting point for most use cases.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Explicit cache breakpoints: Place cache_control directly on individual content blocks for fine-grained control over exactly what gets cached.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Prompt caching uses the following pricing multipliers relative to base input token rates:

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching > Cache operation: 5-minute cache write | Multiplier: 1.25x base input price | Duration: Cache valid for 5 minutes

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching > Cache operation: 1-hour cache write | Multiplier: 2x base input price | Duration: Cache valid for 1 hour

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching > Cache operation: Cache read (hit) | Multiplier: 0.1x base input price | Duration: Same duration as the preceding write

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: Cache write tokens are charged when content is first stored. Cache read tokens are charged when a subsequent request retrieves the cached content. A cache hit costs 10% of the standard input price, which means caching pays off after one cache read for the 5-minute duration (1.25x write), or after two cache reads for the 1-hour duration (2x write).

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: These multipliers stack with other pricing modifiers, including the Batch API discount and data residency.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Prompt caching
blocks.text: For implementation details, supported models, and code examples, see Prompt caching .

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Data residency pricing
blocks.text:  Data residency pricing

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Data residency pricing
blocks.text: For Claude 4.6 and later models, specifying US-only inference through the inference_geo parameter incurs a 1.1x multiplier on all token pricing categories, including input tokens, output tokens, cache writes, and cache reads. Global routing (the default) uses standard pricing.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Data residency pricing
blocks.text: This applies to the Claude API (first-party) and Claude Platform on AWS. On Claude in Microsoft Foundry, the same 1.1x multiplier applies to deployments that use the US Data Zone Standard deployment type (see Inference geography ). Partner-operated platforms (Bedrock and Google Cloud) have independent regional pricing. See Bedrock and Google Cloud for details. Earlier models do not support the inference_geo parameter and always use standard pricing; requests that include the parameter on these models return a 400 error.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Data residency pricing
blocks.text: For more information, see Data residency .

blocks.text:  Fast mode pricing

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Fast mode pricing
blocks.text: Fast mode , in research preview, provides significantly faster output for Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 at premium pricing. Fast mode pricing applies across the full context window, including requests over 200k input tokens. Fast mode is available on the Claude API (first-party) only; it is not available on Claude Platform on AWS or partner-operated cloud platforms.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Fast mode pricing
blocks.text: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Fast mode pricing > Model: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Opus 4.8 | Input: $10 / MTok | Output: $50 / MTok

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Fast mode pricing
blocks.text: Fast mode is not available on Claude Opus 4.7 (requests with speed: "fast" return an error) or Claude Opus 4.6 (requests run at standard speed and are billed at standard rates). See Fast mode .

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Fast mode pricing
blocks.text: Fast mode pricing stacks with other pricing modifiers:

blocks.section: Pricing >  Feature-specific pricing >  Fast mode pricing

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing
blocks.text:  Claude Managed Agents pricing

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing
blocks.text: Claude Managed Agents is billed on two dimensions: tokens and session runtime.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens
blocks.text:  Tokens

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens
blocks.text: All tokens consumed by a Claude Managed Agents session are billed at the rates shown in Model pricing . Prompt caching multipliers apply identically. Web search triggered inside a session incurs the standard $10 per 1,000 searches. On Claude Platform on AWS , session token and runtime charges convert to Claude Consumption Units at the standard rate. Fast mode premium pricing applies when an agent's model.speed is set to "fast" .

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens
blocks.text: The data residency multiplier also applies: when an agent's model.inference_geo is pinned to "us" , tokens consumed by sessions running that agent are billed at 1.1x the standard rates, the same multiplier that applies to US-only inference on the Messages API.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens
blocks.text: The following Messages API modifiers do not apply to Claude Managed Agents sessions:

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens
blocks.text: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens > Modifier: Batch API discount | Why it doesn't apply: Sessions are stateful and interactive. There is no batch mode.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens
blocks.text: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Tokens > Modifier: Cloud platform pricing | Why it doesn't apply: Not available on partner-operated cloud platforms.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Session runtime
blocks.text:  Session runtime

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Session runtime
blocks.text: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Session runtime > SKU: Session runtime | Rate: $0.08 per session-hour | Metering: running status duration

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Session runtime
blocks.text: Runtime is measured to the millisecond and accrues only while the session's status is running . Time spent idle (waiting for your next message or a tool confirmation), rescheduling , or terminated does not count toward runtime.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Claude Managed Agents pricing >  Session runtime
blocks.text: Session runtime replaces the code execution container-hour billing model when using Claude Managed Agents. You are not separately billed for container hours on top of session runtime.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: How is token usage calculated?

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: Tokens are pieces of text that models process. As a rough estimate, 1 token is approximately 4 characters or 0.75 words in English. The exact count varies by language and content type.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: Are there free tiers or trials?

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: New users receive a small amount of free credits to test the API. Contact sales for information about extended trials for enterprise evaluation.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: How do discounts stack?

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: Batch API and prompt caching discounts can be combined. For example, using both features together provides significant cost savings compared to standard API calls. See prompt caching pricing for how the multipliers interact.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: What payment methods are accepted?

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: Major credit cards are accepted for standard accounts. Enterprise customers can arrange invoicing and other payment methods.

blocks.section: Pricing >  Frequently asked questions
blocks.text: For additional questions about pricing, contact support@anthropic.com .
